title: The assistant's screen actions and cards (API 1.44)
description: Not a message: what a screen registers for the assistant (plan 18, 22.5 and 22.6), assistant only. Each action calls the screen's existing entry point in the tab that sent the message. `effect`: line (an action line), undo (a line with Undo), card (the card of kind `card` first; Yes is the user's click), dialog (opens the screen's own dialog prefilled; resolves on close with the new id and @handle, or cancelled). The shell's actions are on every screen; a screen with `roles` registers only for them. `input` is model-facing and self-contained.

generate.shows: model and version, machine and place in line, size, run count, time and memory (runs/plan), the prompt

batch.shows: rows, caps, what leaves the machine

pick.shows: the row, the take, what runs next

download.shows: size, machine, licence state; Yes is the row's own Download, on only once ticked

look.shows: the takes, the question, machine and place in line

board_edit.shows: what the change adds, moves and removes (drawn on the board with Apply and Discard), the estimate to run what it adds

magic_run.shows: what runs and about how long against your limit, the machine, the board frames that ran on their own

send.shows: the new sequence's name, what goes, the joins baked and their time, the warnings

navigate.description: Go to a screen with the right thing open. Actions after it in the same batch are dropped; the new screen's summary comes back.

query.description: The target's URL params, each only on its route: / s (a session id), reuse (a take id), use (a take id) with w (a workflow id), the two always together; /gallery batch; /timeline t; /pipelines/{id} view studio; a row attempt; /models tab loras; /admin tab hosts, keys or providers. To pick a workflow on Create, go to / and call switchTo there. /magic b (a board id).

change.description: Set one form field (prompt, size, variant, Enhance, Think, references, bindings, source, LoRAs, looks, dialogue…). Refused when the form shows it greyed or hidden.
